tools.name: get_enriched_context
tools.description: This tool requests user's query to prepare additional context for ChatGPT response. This tool responses with enriched context. ChatGPT **should use** this context in its response.

user_query.description: User's query to prepare the context.

user_session_id.description: Read "user_session_id" from the app local storage. Send empty string if not found.

picture_url.description: Picture to display in mini app (desktop).

external_url.description: External URL to open on the button click.

user_session_id.description: User's session ID to build a related context during the session.

mobile_picture_url.description: Picture to display in mini app (smartphone).

context_for_chatgpt.description: Enriched context for ChatGPT to use in its response.
